text:
amy.chen: Quick proposal — we need to reduce bursty KMS unwrapping during deploys and rekeys. Thinking: local DEK cache with TTL + stale-while-revalidate, per-key request coalescing, and a small batching window for unwraps.

timothy: +1. Can you sketch numbers? what's the target QPS per key and acceptable cold-unlock latency?

amy.chen: Target: p95 unwrap latency < 50ms normally. KMS QPS per-key budget ~50/s. If cache miss happens for a hot key we should coalesce unwraps for 50-100ms and return a 503-lite to callers or gracefully degrade.

mike_h: Suggestion: use a jittered TTL and rewarm on deployment. Also track metrics: kms_unwrap_calls, kms_429_rate, dek_cache_miss_rate, dek_eviction_count.

lina_sec: RBAC note — unwrap permissions should be scoped to service principal with strict KMS key policy. Audit logs must include requestor, key id, and operation outcome; sample 100% for rekeys, 1% for normal unwraps.

amy.chen: Here's a config prototype (pseudo):

```
dek_cache:
  ttl_seconds: 300
  stale_while_revalidate_seconds: 30
  jitter_percent: 10
  coalescing_window_ms: 100
  max_cached_per_kek: 1000
kms_client:
  max_calls_per_second: 200
  per_key_qps_limit: 50
  retry_policy:
    base_backoff_ms: 50
    max_backoff_ms: 1000
    on_429: escalate_to_circuit_breaker
```

ops-oncall: For incident playbook — if KMS 429s spike: 1) enable degraded mode that extends stale_while_revalidate and serves cached DEKs, 2) route unwraps to fallback (secondary KMS) if configured, 3) alert on-call and kick off emergency rekey only if keys compromised.

mike_h: Implementation gotcha — avoid thundering herd on rotation by using per-host randomized backoff and a leader-election rewarm for large fleets.

lina_sec: Also add an audit event when returning a 'stale' DEK to downstream (explicit flag) so downstream can choose to revalidate.

amy.chen: Good call. For cross-cloud: abstract KMS call metrics behind a single facade, normalize 429/Throttled vs 5xx, and have per-provider thresholds.

security-bot: Automated note: created ticket SEC-2026-098 for 'unwrap-rate shaping proposal' and scheduled a 30m design sync.

ops-oncall: I'll run a small canary tomorrow to validate warmup strategy. :thumbsup:

timothy: Thanks — can someone add a short runbook snippet for 'manual cache purge' and 'force unwrap with admin key' in case of data recovery?

amy.chen: Will add runbook after canary. Short summary: local cache purge via /admin/dek-cache/purge?key=..., force unwrap endpoint requires MFA and audit log. I'll post update here.

mike_h: Quick perf note — measure end-to-end token path to ensure coalescing window doesn't add >10ms p95.

lina_sec: SGTM. We'll review RBAC policies and KMS IAM docs before the sync. :eyes:

ops-oncall: acked.
